overview.caption: Figure 3: This flowchart shows how a personalized health pamphlet is generated. After the user interacts with a virtual agent, their responses are saved as a JSON file, formatted into a prompt, and sent to GPT-4-Turbo to create a customized pamphlet with tailored visuals and a PDF download option.

Virtual Agent Interaction.function_description: Engages the user in a dialogue to provide basic health education and collect personal information (demographics, family history, lifestyle).
Virtual Agent Interaction.technical_details: 3D-animated character rendered in real-time; simulates face-to-face dialogue with synthetic speech and synchronized nonverbal behaviors (BEAT engine); scripted using hierarchical transition networks.

mermaid_spec.definition_code: AgentInteraction["Agent provide basic education for users and asked questions to collect personal data during conversation"]

Data Serialization.function_description: Saves the user responses collected during the agent interaction into a structured format.
Data Serialization.technical_details: Exports user dialogue data as a JSON file containing responses to tailoring questions.

mermaid_spec.definition_code: JSONStorage["User Responses Saved as JSON format"]

Prompt Engineering System.function_description: Constructs a structured prompt for the LLM by combining user-specific data with standardized medical content.
Prompt Engineering System.technical_details: Integrates user data (from JSON) with content from the American Cancer Society's Breast Cancer Fact Sheet to ensure clinical accuracy while enabling personalization.

mermaid_spec.definition_code: PromptFormatter["System formats a structured prompt combining user data and standard educational content"]

LLM Content Generation.function_description: Generates the personalized text for the health pamphlet based on the provided prompt.
LLM Content Generation.technical_details: Uses OpenAI's GPT-4-Turbo API; adapts messaging based on sociodemographic characteristics and risk factors; preserves original fact sheet structure but dynamically adjusts content.

mermaid_spec.definition_code: LLMService["Structured Prompt is sent to OpenAI's GPT-4-turbo API for personalized content generation"]

Pamphlet Rendering.function_description: Compiles the generated text and appropriate visuals into a final digital pamphlet for the user.
Pamphlet Rendering.technical_details: Incorporates the user's name; selects visual figures to reflect the user's stated racial or ethnic background; provides a PDF download option.

io_signature.input_type: Customized text, User demographic data (for visuals)
